implemented_features: PanelContainer Card base with mouse hover tween scaling (card_base.gd)
Drag and drop card physics with lane collision check (_gui_input & check_drop)
Energy management and max capacity scaling (GameManager.gd)
Deck management: draw pile, discard pile, reshuffling (DeckManager.gd)
Lane placement & board attack calculations (Lane.gd, main.tscn)
Multi-tier AI Profiles: Easy (random), Medium (heuristic), Hard (simulated combat scoring) (OpponentManager.gd)
Card archetypes (Dealer, Slot Guard, Card Shark, Pit Boss, Bouncer, Jackpot King, High Roller)
roadmap_to_professional_game: Phase 1: Turn transition banners & UI polish (Player Turn / Opponent Turn overlays, victory/defeat popups)
Phase 2: Particle VFX & card play animations (VFX spawners, damage popups, card attack animations)
Phase 3: Audio system (Sound manager for card drag, drop, attack sounds, background music)
Phase 4: Deck customization UI & Main Menu screen
